tool_schemas.name: get_user_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects owned by the specified user and returns a paged result set sorted by the requested field/direction, where `limit` controls page size and `cursor` retrieves the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `user_id`/filters/sort fields are invalid or `limit` is out of range, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the given user, and NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

user_id.description: ID of the user whose projects to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_project_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single project by `project_id` and returns the project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token is not allowed to access the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_project_with_data
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a project and optionally embeds its tasks and kanban columns; when tasks are included, they are returned as a paged list using `task_limit` and `task_cursor` and can be filtered/sorted via the `task_*` parameters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, or out-of-range limits, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project to fetch with associated data.

include_tasks.description: Whether to include tasks in the response.

include_columns.description: Whether to include kanban columns in the response.

task_limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to include.

task_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for included tasks.

task_sort_by.description: Field to sort included tasks by.

tool_schemas.name: create_project
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project owned by `user_id` and returns the created project record with its generated ID. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including empty `name`), UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot create projects for the specified user, and NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

user_id.description: ID of the user who will own the project.

color.description: Project color (vendor-defined string, e.g. hex code).

view_mode.description: Default view mode for the project.

sort_order.description: Manual sort order for the project in the user's list.

tool_schemas.name: update_project
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing project and returns the updated project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is malformed, updates contain invalid values, or an invalid status is requested, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot modify the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed for the project’s current state, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project to update.

color.description: Updated project color (vendor-defined string, e.g. hex code).

view_mode.description: Updated view mode for the project.

sort_order.description: Updated manual sort order for the project.

is_archived.description: Set whether the project is archived.

tool_schemas.name: delete_project
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a project by ID, either by marking it deleted (default) or permanently removing it when `hard_delete` is true, and returns the deleted project (or deletion result). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot delete the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the project cannot be deleted in its current state, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project to delete.

hard_delete.description: Whether to permanently delete instead of marking deleted.

tool_schemas.name: get_task_by_ids
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single task by `task_id` within the specified `project_id` and returns the task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either ID is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the project/task, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or if the task does not exist within that project. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project containing the task.

task_id.description: ID of the task to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a task in the specified project for the specified user and returns the created task record; when `column_id` is provided the task is placed in that kanban column. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, timestamps are not RFC3339/ISO-8601, or enums are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot create tasks for the given user/project, and NOT_FOUND if the project (or referenced column, when provided) does not exist. May raise CONFLICT if the task cannot be created due to an invalid project/column relationship, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project to create the task in.

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the task.

column_id.description: ID of the kanban column to place the task in.

is_all_day.description: Whether the task is an all-day item.

sort_order.description: Manual sort order within the project/column.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task (including moving it to a different project and/or column) and returns the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or any supplied fields are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot modify the task or the destination project/column, and NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist (or if a referenced destination project/column does not exist). Raises CONFLICT if the requested move/state change is not allowed (for example, moving a task to a column that does not belong to the target project), and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

task_id.description: ID of the task to update.

is_all_day.description: Whether the task is an all-day task.

project_id.description: Move the task to a different project.

column_id.description: Move the task to a different kanban column.

sort_order.description: Updated sort order within its list/column.

tool_schemas.name: complete_task
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified task as completed and returns the updated task record; if `completed_at` is omitted the server sets it to the current time. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is malformed or `completed_at` is not a valid date-time, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot modify the task, and NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the task cannot be completed from its current state (for example, already completed or deleted), and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

task_id.description: ID of the task to mark as completed.

completed_at.description: Completion timestamp to set (RFC 3339); if omitted, server sets current time.

tool_schemas.name: delete_task
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the task identified by `task_id` and returns a confirmation of deletion (no task payload is returned). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` does not match the required `tt_tsk_...` format, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the task is not owned by the authenticated user, and NOT_FOUND if no such task exists or it is not accessible.

task_id.description: ID of the task to delete.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity resolved from the presented API token, including the user record, token scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid/expired/revoked, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

include_rate_limits.description: Whether to include current rate-limit/quota consumption in the response.

tool_schemas.name: get_project_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks within a project owned by the authenticated user and returns a paged result set. Supports filtering by task status and sorting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs/invalid filters or out-of-range `limit`, UNAUTHORIZED if the API token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is deleted.

project_id.description: ID of the project whose tasks to list.

column_id.description: Filter tasks by kanban column placement.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

metadata.name: TickTick API Server
metadata.description: This backend stores TickTick-like task management data: users connect via API tokens, organize work into projects, and manage tasks within those projects. Core workflows include listing a user’s projects, creating/updating/deleting projects, and creating/updating/completing/deleting tasks; projects
